name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for TaskFlixx
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or a specific workflow? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]")

## 🎨 Proposed Solution / UI Design
Describe the solution you'd like to see. Include mockups, wireframes, or code snippets if possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples of similar implementations in other tools.
